title: Add Oracle of Chance to chat
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Oracle of Chance](https://dramatise.site) to chat
- These are two apps I have created side by side, which are basically quite different. The main one, Oracle of Chance, is a search engine designed to work as a crystal ball, and to give precise YES/NO/M

Fixes #12243

gist.headline: The crystal ball is online
gist.blurb: Oracle of Chance has joined the app garden: a search engine that answers like a crystal ball. Ask the hive a yes-or-no question; the oracle will do its mysterious little computation.
gist.summary: Added Oracle of Chance, a crystal-ball-style search app for precise yes/no-style questions, to the community apps directory and greenhouse.
gist.impact: People browsing pollinations-powered projects can now discover Oracle of Chance at dramatise.site and try its unusual search interface.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a tiny fortune-teller with a lavender wizard hat, warmly consulting a glowing crystal ball beside a retro terminal. Inside the crystal ball, simple pixel text reads YES / NO / MAYBE, while code-vines and small flowers grow around the desk to show this is a community app joining the garden.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny lavender wizard hat, consulting a glowing crystal ball beside a retro computer in a flower-filled garden shed; the crystal ball softly shows pixel-font text: 'YES · NO · MAYBE'. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel lavender-to-peach gradient background, chunky retro sprites, code-plants and vines, warm lighting, lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, nostalgic but beautiful.
